# Summit Customs

> Bespoke and made-to-measure suits, sport coats, tuxedos, wedding suits, custom shirts, footwear and image consulting in Salt Lake City, Utah. Founded by Kobe Apponsah.

- Address: 215 S State St, Suite 575, Salt Lake City, UT 84111
- Phone: (801) 866-9718
- Email: kobe@summitcustomsuits.com
- Hours: by appointment, Monday to Saturday, 10am to 6pm Mountain Time
- Book: https://summitcustomsuits.com/book (complimentary 30-minute consultation, in person or by video)
- Typical timeline: 5 to 8 weeks from consultation to final fitting
- Cloth: 4,000+ cloths including Dormeuil, Scabal, Vitale Barberis Canonico and Holland & Sherry
- Google rating: 5.0
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/summitcustomsuits/

## Journal

- [How Much Does a Custom Suit Cost in Salt Lake City?](https://summitcustomsuits.com/journal/how-much-does-a-custom-suit-cost): What drives the price of a custom suit in Salt Lake City: cloth, construction, fit and details. How to compare quotes, and what each Summit Customs tier includes.
- [Bespoke vs Made-to-Measure vs Off-the-Rack Suits](https://summitcustomsuits.com/journal/bespoke-vs-made-to-measure): The real difference between bespoke, made-to-measure and off-the-rack suits: how each is cut, fitted and built, and which one makes sense for you.
- [Custom Wedding Suit Timeline: When to Order](https://summitcustomsuits.com/journal/wedding-suit-timeline): A month-by-month timeline for a custom wedding suit or tuxedo in Salt Lake City, for grooms, groomsmen and fathers of the bride, so nothing is rushed.
- [How to Choose Suit Fabric for Utah's Climate](https://summitcustomsuits.com/journal/suit-fabrics-for-utah): Hot dry summers, cold winters and big swings in between: how to choose suit fabric for Salt Lake City and Park City, from Super 110s worsted to wool-linen and flannel.
- [Black Tie Guide: Should You Rent or Own a Tuxedo?](https://summitcustomsuits.com/journal/black-tie-guide): What black tie requires, how a tuxedo differs from a black suit, and when owning a custom tuxedo makes more sense than renting, from a Salt Lake City tailor.
- [What to Expect at Your First Custom Suit Consultation](https://summitcustomsuits.com/journal/what-to-expect-at-your-first-fitting): What happens at a custom suit consultation and fitting at Summit Customs in Salt Lake City: how long it takes, what to bring, and what you decide on the day.
- [How to Care for a Custom Suit](https://summitcustomsuits.com/journal/how-to-care-for-a-custom-suit): Make a custom suit last for decades: how to hang, brush, steam, store and travel with tailoring, and why you should dry clean far less than you think.
- [Your First Custom Suit: What to Choose](https://summitcustomsuits.com/journal/first-custom-suit): Buying your first custom suit? The colour, cloth, cut and details that work hardest, and the mistakes to avoid, from a Salt Lake City tailor.
